title: Learning AI by building with it.
description: Meet Lisandro de Cuba, an AI practitioner sharing practical lessons from Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI.
body:
My name is Lisandro de Cuba.  I’ve worked with Microsoft technology for more than 25 years, but I still remember how confusing a new platform can feel when you first open it.

Today, I am fortunate to be able to work with AI on a dialy basis, mainly with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry .  I find it fun to learn AI with AI. Doing is the best way to learn.

What i build trying to explain features or capabilities i always build on my own tenant, but scenario's i depend on ai generated suggestions. 

This blog was created because I enjoy sharing what I learn. This blog is for beginners and intermediate users who want to understand Microsoft AI through clear explanations and practical examples.

I also apart of technology try to include best practices when it comes to security and governance.

Hope you enjoy.

Regards
Lisandro
